Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Blink: Renders target impervious to most magic damage for one attack.</br>Duration: 30s
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Cure III: Restores own or target party member's HP and all party members nearby target.</br>Cure Potency: 30,000
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Holy: Deals unaspected damage with a potency of 500 to target and all enemies nearby it.</br>Potency increases to 750 when used against undead enemies.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Occult Raise: Resurrects target to a weakened state.</br>Can also be cast on targets with Resurrection Restricted.
